briefdescription.para: C++ header file with inline implementations for the deprecated µTest++ definitions.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the inline implementations for the deprecated definitions declared in deprecated.h: the v5.0.1 names of the logical functions (_not, _and, and _or), which forward to negate(), all_of(), and any_of(), the overloaded operators, the user-defined literals, and approx (value, epsilon), and the members of the detail::timestamp class.
The constructor of detail::timestamp that reads the system clock is defined in src/deprecated.cpp, with detail::read_clock(), the clock access used by detail::stopwatch.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.
The header files are organised within the include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
